title: Advice for adding hitboxes to Diablo II 3d mod
author: Working-Pen-4838
selftext:
So I’ve been for a while trying to add correct hitbox registration to Diablo II 3d mod so we don’t have to click at the feet of the monsters anymore we can hover and click on their bodies , well I got it to work for the most part except at certain angles and sometimes the mosnters when close to one another when u hover your cursor over the monster, you want to select it, tries to highlight and select the neighboring monster, and a lot of the times you have to be within close distance.

I had a fix before on a different attempt where I could get the monsters to highlight at a distance, but I could also have my cursor at the ground and it’s still trying to select monsters. I’m not sure how to come up with a fix for this and I’m also trying to use Claude to help better implement a sky box that I’ve been seeing in the Diablo two VR mods. I can’t send a video right now of the problem

I can say that after 2 weeks of using Claude within Devin desktop I’ve been able to make changes to the 3d mod and add wasd support , analog movement , fixing pick Registration for the monsters for your cursor to select , cows, archers in camp barbarians or other npcs u cant interact with no longer show “an evil force” health bar or highlight allow u to click them

You can hover anywhere on quest or shop npcs on there arms or legs and it now registers that ur hovering over them allowing u to select

Fixed doors and waypoints and shrines where u had to click at the ground of the object to interact with it- you can now just hover over what your trying to interact with and it will let you

Added a changeable sensitivity function for you to pan your camera faster when trying to turn with A/D on your keyboard

In act 5 the rocks and wood wasn’t rendering it was showing the geometry but was black it didn’t render its textures I got that fixed where more textures are rendering properly

the ground in act 5 has trouble rendering sometimes ,depending on what elevation your at and I had a fix but i broke it again

The stairs only let u run diagonally up and down and im trying to fix that where you can run up and down freely and it doesnt feel like its forcing u up and down the stairs ,

Fixed elevation targeting where a monster is higher or lower in elevation then u (act5) and you can still hover over them and select them before you couldn’t it’s like to the cursor the monster wasn’t there despite u hovering over it

Many more stuff I’ve fixed and added in but I would love some advice or pointers and how can I get people to test this  
I’m loving what I’ve added it feels like I can enjoy the game in a new way like I’ve played other 3d Arpgs in the past

If anyone has any advice on what I should do , what GitHub repos to utilize,

Sorry if my grammar is bad I’m not the best at it
